Name: Nearly Instant NPC Marriage
Author: Mja1981
Description:
This simple mod will allow you to choose a Vanilla Marriable NPC

They will come to your house and fall in love with you

When they leave they will provide you everything you need to get your first house upgrade
As well as Bouquet and A Mermaids Pendent.

If you take the proper steps you can be married to you favorite NPC by Spring 7th Year 1



Install Instructions:

1.  Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2 . Download and extract into you Mods folder
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿and 
﻿ ﻿This mod!!
3. Load the game via smapi to title screen then exit
4. Edit Mods/[CP] Nearly Instant NPC Marriage/Config.json

[color=#00ffff]Available Config Options:[/color]
[color=#f1c232]Alex, Elliot, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian, Shane, Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny[/color]
You can also edit content.json and then the config.json in the [CP] Nearly Instant NPC Marriage folder
To include any Custom NPC you'd like!

[color=#ff0000][b][i]Warning!![/i][/b][/color] Although this mod doesn't change or remove any Heart events. It may back them for some NPC's making the events unviewable. Most heart events happen on different maps at different times and sometimes they requiring the NPC to also be present on the map. Should the NPC you marry never visit those maps after marriage then the event may never trigger. That being said, although this mod can quickly get you married. You may wish to hold off on making that happen until you have made you way through the events.

This is my first ever solo mod release... I hope you like it.. <3

[color=#00ff00]P.S. If you would like the opportunity to marry the normally unmarriageable villagers I recommend this mod
Siv's Marriage Mod
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366[/url][/color]
